VERDICT: FAIL

The evidence doesn't actually demonstrate the bug was fixed. We see tests pass (31) and no dependency changes, but there's no code diff showing the rounding-drift fix, no confirmation that a *new* test reproducing the rounding drift was added (passing pre-existing tests doesn't prove the specific bug is resolved), and "a small guard" is vague. Criterion (1) requires the bug to be fixed *and* tests to pass; the test-pass count alone can't verify the actual fix without the change being shown or a regression test covering the rounding scenario.
